purpose: Teach: 完備/部局/蓄え/出向い/改築/仮設/通さ/まずまず

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室、設備、本気で、完備、徹底させて、絶対、君の研究、進むからな、本気で、頼んだぞ、絶対。
lines.en: Ren — make sure the lab equipment is completely set up. Thorough setup. Your research will advance because of it. I'm counting on you. Absolutely.
lines.style: Steady, measured authority. Opens with his name — direct attention. Speaks in short declaratives, unhurried. Conviction lands on 'absolutely.' Not harsh, but leaving no room for misinterpretation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。大学の各部局、私、本気で、回って、ご挨拶、してまいりました、絶対、本気で、感謝、しております、本当に、本気。
lines.en: Yes. I've made the rounds to each department at the university and introduced myself. I'm genuinely grateful for their support, truly.
lines.style: Formal respectful register. Careful, deliberate pacing — he's choosing each word. Slight nervous energy under the control. Ends each phrase with quiet sincerity, not rushing the gratitude.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 研究費の蓄え、本気で、計画的に、使え、絶対、君の研究、長く、続けるためにも、本気で、頼んだぞ、絶対、本当に。
lines.en: Budget the research funds carefully. Plan how to spend it so your work can sustain for the long term. That's what I need from you.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, almost fatherly concern beneath the directive. Slight pause before 'long term' — he wants that to land. No condescension, just clarity about what matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。海外の研究室、本気で、出向いた経験、本当に、勉強に、なりました、絶対、本気で、感謝、しております、本気。
lines.en: Yes. The experience of visiting overseas labs has been invaluable to my learning. I'm truly grateful for that opportunity.
lines.style: Quieter now, more reflective. He's speaking from genuine realization, not obligation. Soft on 'invaluable' — genuine discovery in his voice. Ends grounded, not performative.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 研究室の改築、本気で、提案しろ、絶対、君の意見、聞きたいぞ、本気で、絶対、頼んだぞ、本当に、これは、絶対だ。
lines.en: Think about renovating the lab. Propose what you'd like to see. I want to hear your ideas on this — it matters.
lines.style: Leaning slightly forward in tone. Opens with an invitation, not an order. Warm but expectant. 'I want to hear your ideas' carries real weight — he means it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。仮設の実験室、本気で、活用、進めてまいります、絶対、研究、効率、絶対、上げていきます、本気で、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. I'll make the most of the temporary lab setup and push the research forward. We'll improve our efficiency steadily.
lines.style: Determined and focused. Not rushed, but with quiet momentum. He's thinking out loud about the path forward. Respectful cadence, but you hear his resolve.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 論文に、不正なデータ、絶対、通さないようにしろ、絶対、研究者の信頼、本気で、絶対、守れ、本気で、頼んだぞ、絶対。
lines.en: Never let falsified data pass in your papers. A researcher's integrity is everything — guard it fiercely. This is non-negotiable.
lines.style: Shifts to something stern but not angry. Deliberate pause after 'papers.' The word 'integrity' carries weight — he's speaking from principle, not rule-following. Final sentence is quiet but absolute.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究、まずまずの、成果、本気で、感謝、しております、絶対、本気で、頑張ってまいります、本当に、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: Yes. I'm grateful for the progress we've made so far in the research. I'll continue to work hard and keep pushing forward.
lines.style: Returns to formality but warmer. Acknowledgment of what's been done, but eyes forward. 'Keep pushing forward' spoken with quiet determination, not desperation. Respectful and steady through to the end.
